cells.title: Wait for the real condition in the four release-gate flaky tests
cells.action: Tests only; no product code. (1) Per D2: in herding/run.rs test `pihp_unique_job_id_concurrent_cli_processes_cannot_share_default_id`, the loop `if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("JOB_ID:")` misses the id when tests run single-threaded, because libtest prints `test <name> ... ` on the same line before the child's `JOB_ID:<id>`. Find `JOB_ID:` anywhere in the line (e.g. `line.find("JOB_ID:")` and take the rest after it, trimmed). (2) Per D1: in tests/pi_plugin_contracts.rs the node harness has polling steps `await_messages` and `await_switches` (each loops `while (<array>.length < want && Date.now() < deadline) await sleep(25)` and pushes a step result). Add two steps the same way: `await_notification` with `contains` (poll until some entry of `notifications` has a `message` that includes the string) and `await_order_entry` with `entry` (poll until `orderLog` includes that exact entry); both take `timeout_ms` (default 10000) and push a result step like `{notification_seen: bool}` / `{order_entry_seen: bool}`. Add Rust helpers next to `fn sleep_step` (e.g. `fn await_notification_step(contains: &str) -> Value` and `fn await_order_entry_step(entry: &str) -> Value`) that pass `"timeout_ms": positive_wait_ms()`. Then: in `deferred_transition_rejects_forged_marker` case 1 replace `sleep_step(50)` with `await_notification_step("deferred transition intent failed authenticity validation")`; in `deferred_exit_ordering_settled_fork_switch_replacement_merge` replace `sleep_step(300)` with `await_order_entry_step("withSession_end")`; in `exit_worktree_marker_relocates_and_no_merge_command_runs` replace `sleep_step(300)` with `await_notification_step("worktree was kept")`. Keep every assertion unchanged. Update the doc line above run_harness that lists the timer-facing step kinds only if it is a doc comment you must keep true; add no new comments. Proof: run the verify (it runs both modes); run the Pi target three times in parallel mode to show it no longer flakes. No code comments.
cells.verify: RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee pihp_unique_job_id && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test pi_plugin_contracts && RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test pi_plugin_contracts

truths: the job-id test passes with RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 and in parallel
the three Pi tests wait for their condition instead of a fixed sleep
pi_plugin_contracts passes in parallel and single-threaded
